Explore OpenTelemetry traces stored in the .traces dataset

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/tracing/explore-traces](https://docs.bronto.io/tracing/explore-traces)
:::

```sh
bronto traces <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto traces aggregate`](/reference/commands/traces/#bronto-traces-aggregate) | Aggregate span attribute values across traces |
| [`bronto traces list`](/reference/commands/traces/#bronto-traces-list) | List individual spans |
| [`bronto traces operations`](/reference/commands/traces/#bronto-traces-operations) | Show span counts and latency per service and operation |
| [`bronto traces services`](/reference/commands/traces/#bronto-traces-services) | Show span counts and latency per service |
| [`bronto traces shape`](/reference/commands/traces/#bronto-traces-shape) | Show the merged call-tree shape across a sample of traces |
| [`bronto traces show`](/reference/commands/traces/#bronto-traces-show) | Render a single trace as a waterfall |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto traces aggregate

Aggregate span attribute values across traces

```sh
bronto traces aggregate [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all-spans` |  | bool |  | consider all spans, not just roots |
| `--by` | `-b` | stringArray |  | attribute to group by (repeatable, required) |
| `--errors` |  | bool |  | only error spans |
| `--include-empty` |  | bool |  | include rows where an attribute is missing |
| `--kind` | `-k` | string |  | filter by span kind, e.g. server or client |
| `--limit` | `-n` | int | `50` | max rows |
| `--root-only` |  | bool | `true` | only consider root spans |
| `--service` | `-s` | string |  | filter by service name |
| `--since` |  | string |  | relative lookback (default 15m) |
| `--where` | `-w` | string |  | additional raw WHERE clause |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto traces aggregate --by http.route
bronto traces aggregate --by db.system --all-spans --kind client
```

## bronto traces list

List individual spans

```sh
bronto traces list [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--errors` |  | bool |  | only error spans |
| `--limit` | `-n` | int | `50` | max spans |
| `--min-duration-ms` |  | float |  | only spans at least this many milliseconds long |
| `--operation` |  | string |  | filter by operation (span) name |
| `--service` | `-s` | string |  | filter by service name |
| `--since` |  | string |  | relative lookback (default 15m) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto traces list -s checkout-service --errors
bronto traces list --min-duration-ms 500 -n 20
```

## bronto traces shape

Show the merged call-tree shape across a sample of traces

```sh
bronto traces shape [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--any-span` |  | bool |  | sample by any matching span, not just entries |
| `--bar-width` |  | int | `50` | waterfall bar width in characters |
| `--entry` |  | bool | `true` | sample by entry (server) spans |
| `--errors` |  | bool |  | only error spans/traces |
| `--min-duration-ms` |  | float |  | only entry spans at least this many milliseconds long |
| `--min-traces` |  | int | `1` | drop buckets present in fewer than this many traces |
| `--operation` |  | string |  | filter by operation (span) name |
| `--sample` |  | int | `30` | number of traces to sample |
| `--service` | `-s` | string |  | filter by service name |
| `--since` |  | string |  | relative lookback (default 1h) |
| `--where` | `-w` | string |  | additional raw WHERE clause |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto traces shape -s checkout-service --sample 20
bronto traces shape --any-span --operation 'SELECT users'
```

## bronto traces show

Render a single trace as a waterfall

```sh
bronto traces show <trace-id> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bar-width` |  | int | `40` | waterfall bar width in characters |
| `--limit` | `-n` | int | `500` | max spans to fetch |
| `--since` |  | string |  | relative lookback (default 1h) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto traces show 4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736
bronto traces show <trace-id> --since 6h -n 200
```
